```{r fetch_prices}
# ── Busca precos e sparklines via quantmod / Yahoo Finance ────────────────────

make_sparkline_svg <- function(prices, width = 80, height = 28, color = "#2c5f2e") {
  if (length(prices) < 2) return("")
  prices <- as.numeric(prices)
  prices <- prices[!is.na(prices)]
  if (length(prices) < 2) return("")

  mn <- min(prices); mx <- max(prices)
  rng <- mx - mn
  if (rng == 0) rng <- 1

  xs <- round((seq_along(prices) - 1) / (length(prices) - 1) * width, 2)
  ys <- round((1 - (prices - mn) / rng) * height, 2)
  points <- paste(xs, ys, sep = ",", collapse = " ")

  last_color <- if (tail(prices, 1) >= prices[1]) "#2c5f2e" else "#dc2626"

  glue(
    '<svg width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" ',
    'xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;">',
    '<polyline points="{points}" fill="none" stroke="{last_color}" stroke-width="1.5" ',
    'stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
    '</svg>'
  )
}

fetch_prices <- function(tickers, days_back = 30) {
  map_dfr(tickers, function(tk) {
    tryCatch({
      getSymbols(tk, src = "yahoo", auto.assign = FALSE,
                 from = Sys.Date() - days_back - 5,
                 to   = Sys.Date()) -> raw

      cls   <- as.numeric(Cl(raw))
      dates <- index(raw)

      # Filtra apenas dias uteis com dados
      cls   <- cls[!is.na(cls)]
      n     <- length(cls)
      if (n < 2) return(tibble(ticker = tk, price = NA_real_, weekly_chg = NA_real_, sparkline = ""))

      price      <- tail(cls, 1)
      price_1w   <- if (n >= 6) cls[n - 5] else cls[1]
      weekly_chg <- round((price / price_1w - 1) * 100, 2)
      sparkline  <- make_sparkline_svg(cls)

      tibble(ticker = tk, price = round(price, 2), weekly_chg = weekly_chg, sparkline = sparkline)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(glue("[Prices] Error {tk}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
      tibble(ticker = tk, price = NA_real_, weekly_chg = NA_real_, sparkline = "")
    })
  })
}

prices_df <- fetch_prices(ticker_map$ticker)
```

```{r filter_functions}
# ── Filtra noticias irrelevantes via blacklist ─────────────────────────────────

filter_news <- function(df, ticker_key) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)

  # Palavras globais + especificas do ticker
  words <- c(
    news_blacklist[["global"]],
    if (!is.null(news_blacklist[[ticker_key]])) news_blacklist[[ticker_key]] else character()
  )

  if (length(words) == 0) return(df)

  pattern <- paste(words, collapse = "|")

  df |>
    filter(!grepl(pattern, tolower(titulo), fixed = FALSE))
}
```

```{r fetch_functions}
fetch_google_news <- function(ticker, nome, query_google, days_back = DAYS_BACK, ...) {
  url <- glue("https://news.google.com/rss/search?q={URLencode(query_google)}&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en")
  tryCatch({
    feed <- tidyRSS::tidyfeed(url, clean_tags = TRUE)
    if (is.null(feed) || nrow(feed) == 0) return(empty_news())
    result <- feed |>
      mutate(ticker = ticker, nome = nome, fonte = "Google News",
             publicado = as.POSIXct(item_pub_date, tz = "America/Sao_Paulo")) |>
      filter(publicado >= Sys.time() - days(days_back)) |>
      select(ticker, nome, fonte,
             titulo = item_title, link = item_link,
             veiculo = item_feed_title, publicado)
    if (nrow(result) == 0) empty_news() else result
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Google] Error {ticker}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    empty_news()
  })
}

fetch_newsapi <- function(ticker, nome, query_newsapi, days_back = DAYS_BACK, ...) {
  if (is.na(NEWSAPI_KEY) || NEWSAPI_KEY == "") return(empty_news())
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request("https://newsapi.org/v2/everything") |>
      req_url_query(q = query_newsapi,
                    from = format(Sys.Date() - days_back, "%Y-%m-%d"),
                    sortBy = "publishedAt", language = "en",
                    pageSize = 10, apiKey = NEWSAPI_KEY) |>
      req_perform() |> resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)
    arts <- resp$articles
    if (is.null(arts) || length(arts) == 0) return(empty_news())
    arts <- as_tibble(arts)
    if (nrow(arts) == 0) return(empty_news())
    result <- arts |>
      mutate(ticker = ticker, nome = nome, fonte = "NewsAPI",
             publicado = as.POSIXct(publishedAt, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC") |>
               with_tz("America/Sao_Paulo"),
             veiculo = if (is.data.frame(source)) source$name else as.character(source)) |>
      filter(publicado >= Sys.time() - days(days_back)) |>
      select(ticker, nome, fonte, titulo = title, link = url, veiculo, publicado)
    if (nrow(result) == 0) empty_news() else result
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[NewsAPI] Error {ticker}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    empty_news()
  })
}

fetch_all_news <- function(days_back = DAYS_BACK) {
  ticker_map |>
    pmap_dfr(function(ticker, nome, query_google, query_newsapi) {
      message(glue("  Fetching: {nome} ({ticker})"))
      g <- fetch_google_news(ticker, nome, query_google, days_back)
      Sys.sleep(SLEEP_SEC)
      n <- fetch_newsapi(ticker, nome, query_newsapi, days_back)
      combined <- bind_rows(g, n)
      if (nrow(combined) > 0 && any(!is.na(combined$titulo) & combined$titulo != "")) {
        combined <- combined |>
          filter(!is.na(titulo), titulo != "") |>
          distinct(titulo, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
          filter_news(ticker_key = ticker) |>   # <-- filtro aqui
          arrange(desc(publicado))
      }
      combined
    })
}
```

```{r groq_functions}
groq_summarize <- function(headlines_text, commodity_name, model = GROQ_MODEL) {
  if (is.na(GROQ_KEY) || GROQ_KEY == "") return(NULL)
  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are a commodity market analyst. Below are news headlines from the past week ",
    "about ", commodity_name, " futures markets.\n\n",
    "Headlines:\n", headlines_text, "\n\n",
    "Write a concise market summary (3-5 sentences) covering:\n",
    "1. The main price drivers or trends mentioned\n",
    "2. Key supply/demand factors\n",
    "3. Any relevant geopolitical or weather events\n",
    "4. Overall market sentiment (bullish/bearish/neutral)\n\n",
    "Be direct and analytical. Do not repeat headlines verbatim."
  )
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request("https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions") |>
      req_headers("Authorization" = paste("Bearer", GROQ_KEY),
                  "Content-Type"  = "application/json") |>
      req_body_json(list(
        model    = model,
        messages = list(
          list(role = "system", content = "You are a concise commodity market analyst. Always respond in English."),
          list(role = "user",   content = prompt)
        ),
        temperature = 0.3,
        max_tokens  = 300
      )) |>
      req_timeout(30) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_body_json()
    resp$choices[[1]]$message$content
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Groq] Error for {commodity_name}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    NULL
  })
}

generate_all_summaries <- function(df) {
  if (is.na(GROQ_KEY) || GROQ_KEY == "") {
    return(tibble(ticker = character(), nome = character(), summary = character()))
  }
  df |>
    filter(!is.na(titulo), titulo != "") |>
    group_by(ticker, nome) |>
    summarise(headlines = paste(titulo, collapse = "\n- "), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(summary = map2_chr(headlines, nome, function(h, name) {
      Sys.sleep(0.5)
      result <- groq_summarize(h, name)
      if (is.null(result)) "No news available this week." else result
    })) |>
    select(ticker, nome, summary)
}

summaries_df <- generate_all_summaries(news_df)

summaries_df <- ticker_map |>
  select(ticker, nome) |>
  left_join(summaries_df, by = c("ticker", "nome")) |>
  mutate(summary = ifelse(is.na(summary), "No news found for this commodity this week.", summary))

readr::write_csv(summaries_df, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, glue("summaries_{Sys.Date()}.csv")))
```

```{r groq_portfolio}
groq_portfolio_summary <- function(summaries_df) {
  if (is.na(GROQ_KEY) || GROQ_KEY == "") return(NULL)

  all_summaries <- summaries_df |>
    mutate(block = glue("{nome} ({ticker}): {summary}")) |>
    pull(block) |>
    paste(collapse = "\n\n")

  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are a senior commodity portfolio analyst. Below are individual weekly summaries ",
    "for each commodity in an agricultural futures portfolio.\n\n",
    all_summaries, "\n\n",
    "Write a comprehensive portfolio-level market brief (5-7 sentences) that:\n",
    "1. Identifies the dominant macro theme across the portfolio this week\n",
    "2. Highlights the top 2-3 commodities with the most significant moves or news\n",
    "3. Notes any cross-commodity correlations or common drivers (weather, USD, energy)\n",
    "4. Gives an overall portfolio sentiment (risk-on / risk-off / mixed)\n",
    "5. Flags any key events or reports to watch next week\n\n",
    "Be direct, analytical, and concise. Write as a professional market brief."
  )

  tryCatch({
    resp <- request("https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions") |>
      req_headers("Authorization" = paste("Bearer", GROQ_KEY),
                  "Content-Type"  = "application/json") |>
      req_body_json(list(
        model    = GROQ_MODEL,
        messages = list(
          list(role = "system", content = "You are a senior commodity portfolio analyst. Always respond in English."),
          list(role = "user",   content = prompt)
        ),
        temperature = 0.3,
        max_tokens  = 500
      )) |>
      req_timeout(40) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_body_json()
    resp$choices[[1]]$message$content
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Groq] Portfolio summary error: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    NULL
  })
}

portfolio_summary <- groq_portfolio_summary(summaries_df)
```

```{r portfolio_overview}
# ── Tabela de precos + sparklines ─────────────────────────────────────────────
price_table <- ticker_map |>
  left_join(prices_df,      by = "ticker") |>
  left_join(ticker_counts |> select(ticker, n), by = "ticker")

rows <- price_table |>
  pmap(function(ticker, nome, price, weekly_chg, sparkline, n, ...) {

    # Variacao semanal formatada
    chg_color <- if (is.na(weekly_chg)) "#6b7280" else if (weekly_chg >= 0) "#16a34a" else "#dc2626"
    chg_arrow <- if (is.na(weekly_chg)) "" else if (weekly_chg >= 0) "▲" else "▼"
    chg_txt   <- if (is.na(weekly_chg)) "N/A" else paste0(chg_arrow, " ", abs(weekly_chg), "%")
    price_txt <- if (is.na(price)) "N/A" else formatC(price, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")

    # Barra de artigos
    max_n     <- max(price_table$n, 1)
    bar_w     <- round((n / max_n) * 60)
    bar_color <- if (n == 0) "#e5e7eb" else if (n >= 5) "#2c5f2e" else "#86b48a"

    tags$tr(
      tags$td(style = "font-weight:600; color:#1a1a2e;", nome),
      tags$td(tags$code(style = "font-size:.75rem; color:#6b7280;", ticker)),
      tags$td(style = "font-family:monospace; text-align:right;", price_txt),
      tags$td(style = glue("color:{chg_color}; font-weight:600; text-align:right;"), chg_txt),
      tags$td(HTML(sparkline)),
      tags$td(
        div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem;",
          div(style = glue("height:10px; width:{bar_w}px; min-width:3px; background:{bar_color}; border-radius:3px;")),
          tags$span(style = "font-size:.75rem; color:#9ca3af;", n)
        )
      )
    )
  })

div(class = "portfolio-panel",
  tags$table(
    style = "width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;",
    tags$thead(
      tags$tr(
        lapply(c("Commodity", "Ticker", "Price", "7d Change", "30d Chart", "Articles"),
               function(h) tags$th(style = "text-align:left; padding:.4rem .6rem; font-size:.78rem;
                                            color:#6b7280; border-bottom:2px solid #e5e7eb;
                                            font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase;", h))
      )
    ),
    tags$tbody(
      lapply(rows, function(r) {
        htmltools::tagAppendAttributes(r,
          style = "border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6;")
      })
    )

)
```

## Weekly AI Summary

```{r weekly_overview}
sentiment_badge <- function(summary_text) {
  kw_bull <- c("rally","surge","gain","rise","high","strong","bull","upward","demand","support")
  kw_bear <- c("drop","fall","decline","weak","low","bear","downward","surplus","pressure","loss")
  s <- tolower(summary_text)
  b  <- sum(sapply(kw_bull, grepl, x = s))
  br <- sum(sapply(kw_bear, grepl, x = s))
  if (b > br)       tags$span(class = "sentiment bullish", "Bullish")
  else if (br > b)  tags$span(class = "sentiment bearish", "Bearish")
  else              tags$span(class = "sentiment neutral",  "Neutral")
}

cards <- summaries_df |>
  left_join(ticker_counts |> select(ticker, n), by = "ticker") |>
  pmap(function(ticker, nome, summary, n, ...) {
    div(class = "summary-card",
      div(class = "summary-header",
        tags$span(class = "summary-name",   nome),
        tags$code(class = "summary-ticker", ticker),
        sentiment_badge(summary),
        tags$span(class = "summary-count",  paste(n, "articles"))
      ),
      div(class = "summary-body", summary)
    )
  })

tagList(cards)
```

## News by Commodity

```{r render_cards}
make_news_card <- function(titulo, link, veiculo, publicado, fonte, ...) {
  badge_color <- if (fonte == "Google News") "#4285F4" else "#E84393"
  div(class = "news-card",
    div(class = "news-meta",
      tags$span(class = "badge", style = paste0("background:", badge_color), fonte),
      tags$span(class = "veiculo", veiculo),
      tags$span(class = "data", format(publicado, "%m/%d %H:%M"))
    ),
    a(href = link, target = "_blank", class = "news-titulo", titulo)
  )
}

render_ticker_section <- function(ticker_key, df_ticker) {
  nome_display <- unique(df_ticker$nome)[1]
  df_valid     <- df_ticker |> filter(!is.na(titulo), titulo != "")
  n_articles   <- nrow(df_valid)

  cards <- if (n_articles == 0) {
    tags$blockquote(
      style = "color:#9ca3af; border-left:3px solid #e5e7eb; padding-left:1rem;",
      "No articles found for this ticker in the selected period."
    )
  } else {
    df_valid |> arrange(desc(publicado)) |> pmap(make_news_card) |> tagList()
  }

  tagList(
    tags$h2(
      tags$span(nome_display),
      tags$code(style = "margin-left:.5rem; font-size:.75em; color:#6b7280;", ticker_key)
    ),
    tags$p(tags$em(paste0(n_articles, " article(s) found in the last ", DAYS_BACK, " days"))),
    cards
  )
}

sections <- ticker_map |>
  pmap(function(ticker, nome, ...) {
    df_ticker <- news_df |> filter(ticker == !!ticker)

                titulo = NA_character_, link = NA_character_,
                veiculo = NA_character_, publicado = as.POSIXct(NA))
    }
    render_ticker_section(ticker, df_ticker)
  })

tagList(sections)
```

```{r send_email}
# ── Envio do brief por email via blastula + Gmail ─────────────────────────────

send_weekly_email <- function() {

  if (any(c(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_TO) == "")) {
    message("[Email] SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS ou EMAIL_TO nao configurados — pulando envio.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  if (is.null(portfolio_summary)) {
    message("[Email] Portfolio summary nao disponivel — pulando envio.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Monta tabela de precos para o email
  price_rows_html <- price_table |>
    pmap_chr(function(ticker, nome, price, weekly_chg, n, ...) {
      chg_color <- if (is.na(weekly_chg)) "#6b7280" else if (weekly_chg >= 0) "#16a34a" else "#dc2626"
      chg_arrow <- if (is.na(weekly_chg)) "" else if (weekly_chg >= 0) "▲" else "▼"
      chg_txt   <- if (is.na(weekly_chg)) "N/A" else paste0(chg_arrow, abs(weekly_chg), "%")
      price_txt <- if (is.na(price)) "N/A" else formatC(price, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")
      glue('<tr>
        <td style="padding:6px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6; font-weight:600;">{nome}</td>
        <td style="padding:6px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6; font-family:monospace; color:#6b7280;">{ticker}</td>
        <td style="padding:6px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6; text-align:right; font-family:monospace;">{price_txt}</td>
        <td style="padding:6px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6; text-align:right; color:{chg_color}; font-weight:600;">{chg_txt}</td>
        <td style="padding:6px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6; text-align:center; color:#6b7280;">{n} art.</td>
      </tr>')
    }) |>
    paste(collapse = "\n")

  recipients <- strsplit(EMAIL_TO, ",")[[1]] |> trimws()

  email <- compose_email(
    body = blocks(
      block_title("Commodity News Monitor"),
      block_text(glue("Weekly brief — {period}")),
      block_spacer(),

      block_text("<strong style='font-size:1.1rem;'>Portfolio Brief (AI)</strong>"),
      block_text(portfolio_summary),
      block_spacer(),

      block_text("<strong style='font-size:1.1rem;'>Price Summary</strong>"),
      block_text(glue(
        '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.9rem;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="background:#f9fafb;">
              <th style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:left; color:#6b7280;">Commodity</th>
              <th style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:left; color:#6b7280;">Ticker</th>
              <th style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#6b7280;">Price</th>
              <th style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#6b7280;">7d</th>
              <th style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:center; color:#6b7280;">News</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>{price_rows_html}</tbody>
        </table>'
      )),
      block_spacer(),

      block_text(glue(
        '<p style="font-size:.8rem; color:#9ca3af;">',
        'Generated automatically every Friday | PAIC Econometrics / FAE Business School<br>',
        'Full report: <a href="https://paiceconometrics.github.io/site/news.html">View online</a>',
        '</p>'
      ))
    )
  )

  tryCatch({
    smtp_send(
      email,
      to      = recipients,
      from    = SMTP_USER,
      subject = glue("Commodity Weekly Brief — {format(Sys.Date(), '%b %d, %Y')}"),
      credentials = creds_envvar(
        user     = "SMTP_USER",
        pass_envvar = "SMTP_PASS",
        host     = "smtp.gmail.com",
        port     = 465,
        use_ssl  = TRUE
      )
    )
    message(glue("[Email] Sent successfully to: {EMAIL_TO}"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Email] Error: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
  })
}

send_weekly_email()
```
